decision_conditions: The proposed flank windows of the proposed development shall: (a) be of purpose-made obscure glass, (b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level, and shall thereafter be retained in that form.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the side elevation of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.</p>

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp; 250425-DWG-001 Rev A, 250425-DWG-301 Rev A (proposed west
elevation) , &nbsp;250425-DWG-301 Rev A (proposed
north elevation), 250425-DWG-201 Rev A (proposed section B), 250425-DWG-102 Rev
A (proposed second floor plan), 250425-DWG-101 Rev A (proposed first floor plan)
, 250425-DWG-100 Rev A (proposed ground floor plan)<p class="MsoNormal">From previous planning consent PL/0416/24&nbsp;dated
05-09-2024:&nbsp; &nbsp;Location Plan, 00554_01_00_001( Existing Site Plan), Reasonable
Exception Statement and Preliminary statement.&nbsp;&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p>
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.
description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) attached to planning permission PL/2005/24 dated 20/03/2025 to allow alterations to rear extension including installation of window to side elevation
